query: A finite sum of nonnegative real numbers vanishes if and only if every summand vanishes

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}
  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)

items.name: ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ENNReal}, ∑' (i : α), f i = 0 ↔ ∀ (i : α), f i = 0

items.name: Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : PartialOrder M] [AddLeftMono M]
  {f : ι → M}, 0 ≤ f → (∑ i, f i = 0 ↔ f = 0)

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}
  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 0) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [Subsingleton (AddUnits M)],
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

items.name: finsum_mem_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → M} {s : Set α},
  (∀ x ∈ s, f x = 0) → ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), f i = 0

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M},
  (∀ x ∈ s, f x = 0) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x = 0

items.name: Finset.expect_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α]
  [inst_3 : Module ℚ≥0 α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α},
  (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → ((s.expect fun i => f i) = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)
